Meningitis Español About Many things can cause the lining of the brain and spinal cord to swell. Learn More Sept. 9, 2025 Causes Viral Meningitis Many viruses can cause meningitis. How they spread and who is at risk varies by virus. Sept. 9, 2025 Bacterial Meningitis Many bacteria can cause meningitis. How they spread and who is at risk varies by bacteria type. Sept. 9, 2025 Fungal Meningitis Fungal meningitis is uncommon, difficult to diagnose, and treated with antifungal medicines. Parasitic Meningitis Three parasites are the main causes of parasitic meningitis, which is uncommon and hard to diagnose. Amebic Meningitis Amebic meningitis is rare, difficult to diagnose, and usually deadly even with treatment. Healthcare providers Clinical Overview An overview of clinical features, diagnostics, and treatment for fungal meningitis.
